parts.content: Work in D:\PropelExp. Implement EP-002 US_020 TASK_001 and TASK_002 only. Read both task files fully. Follow frozen strict Pydantic models and current architecture. Required files: backend/src/cms_planner/domain/job_event.py, backend/src/cms_planner/modules/extraction/event_sequence.py, backend/src/cms_planner/infrastructure/state/job_event_buffer.py, backend/src/cms_planner/modules/extraction/active_job_guard.py, plus focused tests at each task Build Commands path. Requirements: every event has job_id, increasing event_id per job, allowed stage, percent 0..100, timezone-aware timestamp, terminal status; event type has no document text field and extra fields forbidden; resume strictly after known event ID in order; bounded per-job buffer with explicit capacity; terminal state retained; reject a second active extraction without disrupting original stream, while allowing a new job after terminal completion. Define behavior for stale resume cursor older than retained buffer using a typed error, not silent partial replay. Standard library + Pydantic only. TDD and focused validation after first edit; complexity <=7. Mark validation/checklist boxes [x] in only TASK_001 and TASK_002 after tests pass. Run both suites together and report changed files/results. Do not touch FastAPI route, frontend, or unrelated files.
